description: This file declares the class 'DbusMgr' within the namespace 'WPEFramework::Plugin'. The class provides interface methods to access various NetworkManager proxies and connections via GDBus, encapsulating D-Bus communication for network management functionality.

classes.name: DbusMgr
classes.description: A class that manages D-Bus proxies for NetworkManager, providing methods to retrieve various network proxies and connection objects.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerSettingsConnectionProxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for a specific NetworkManager settings connection identified by the provided path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDeviceProxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for a network device at a given path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerWirelessProxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for a wireless device at a given path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv4Proxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for IPv4 configuration at a given path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerIpv6Proxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for IPv6 configuration at a given path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerActiveConnProxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for an active network connection.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerAccessPointProxy
methods.description: Returns the proxy for a network access point.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Provides access to the GDBusConnection used by the manager.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerPropertyProxy
methods.description: Returns the property proxy for a network device.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv4Proxy
methods.description: Returns the DHCPv4 proxy for a given DHCP configuration path.

methods.name: getNetworkManagerDhcpv6Proxy
methods.description: Returns the DHCPv6 proxy for a given DHCP configuration path.
